Common is code shared by my GHPC mods and stamped whole into each repo. A change meant for this repo goes as an issue or a pull request describing it: I make it in the shared copy and stamp every mod again. In a fork of your own, edit Common as you need and put the file's new SHA-256 on its line below. tests/CommonSealTests.cs fails naming the file and prints the hash.
